<?php
/**
 * Configuration-driven middleware for API gateway routing.
 * Handles tenant isolation and permission delegation.
 */

class TenantConfig {
    private array $routes = [];
    private array $permissions = [];
    private array $rateLimit = [];
    
    public function __construct(array $baseConfig) {
        $this->routes = $baseConfig['routes'] ?? [];
        $this->permissions = $baseConfig['permissions'] ?? [];
        $this->rateLimit = $baseConfig['rate_limit'] ?? [];
    }
    
    public function getRoutes(): array { return $this->routes; }
    public function getPermissions(): array { return $this->permissions; }
    public function getRateLimit(): array { return $this->rateLimit; }
}

class PermissionResolver {
    private array $roleHierarchy;
    
    public function __construct(array $hierarchy) {
        $this->roleHierarchy = $hierarchy;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if a role has access to a given permission scope.
     * Uses indexed lookup for O(1) permission checks.
     */
    public function canAccess(string $role, string $scope, array $overrides = []): bool {
        $effectivePerms = $this->resolveEffective($role, $overrides);
        return in_array($scope, $effectivePerms, true);
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolve effective permissions by merging base with overrides.
     * Overrides allow tenant-specific permission customization.
     */
    private function resolveEffective(string $role, array $overrides): array {
        $base = $this->roleHierarchy[$role] ?? [];
        if (empty($overrides)) {
            return $base;
        }
        // Only allow adding new scopes, never replacing existing ones
        return $this->safeAppend($base, $overrides);
    }
    
    /**
     * Safely append new permission scopes. Only string values from
     * sequential (indexed) arrays are appended. Associative keys and
     * nested structures are ignored to prevent injection.
     */
    private function safeAppend(array $base, array $override): array {
        foreach ($override as $key => $value) {
            if (!is_int($key)) {
                // Skip any associative keys - only sequential additions allowed
                continue;
            }
            if (!is_string($value)) {
                // Skip non-string values
                continue;
            }
            // Only append if not already present
            if (!in_array($value, $base, true)) {
                $base[] = $value;
            }
        }
        return $base;
    }
}

class GatewayMiddleware {
    private TenantConfig $config;
    private PermissionResolver $resolver;
    private array $tenantOverrides = [];
    
    public function __construct(TenantConfig $config, PermissionResolver $resolver) {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->resolver = $resolver;
    }
    
    /**
     * Process tenant customization request.
     * Tenants can customize their own permission scopes within their namespace.
     */
    public function applyTenantCustomization(string $tenantId, array $customization): bool {
        // Validate tenant namespace isolation
        if (!$this->validateNamespace($tenantId, $customization)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Sanitize the customization payload
        $sanitized = $this->sanitizePayload($customization);
        if ($sanitized === null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->tenantOverrides[$tenantId] = $sanitized;
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate that customization stays within tenant's namespace.
     * Prevents cross-tenant permission escalation.
     */
    private function validateNamespace(string $tenantId, array $customization): bool {
        $allowedPrefix = 'tenant.' . $tenantId . '.';
        
        foreach ($customization as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($key)) {
                // String keys must be prefixed with tenant namespace
                if (!str_starts_with($key, $allowedPrefix) && $key !== 'scopes') {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            // Numeric keys are allowed (they represent scope additions)
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Sanitize payload values - only allow strings and arrays of strings.
     */
    private function sanitizePayload(array $payload): ?array {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($payload as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+$/', $value)) {
                    $result[$key] = $value;
                } else {
                    return null;
                }
            } elseif (is_array($value)) {
                $nested = $this->sanitizePayload($value);
                if ($nested === null) return null;
                $result[$key] = $nested;
            } else {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }
    
    /**
     * Handle incoming request with tenant context.
     */
    public function handleRequest(string $tenantId, string $role, string $requestedScope): array {
        $overrides = $this->tenantOverrides[$tenantId] ?? [];
        
        // Extract scope overrides if present
        $scopeOverrides = $overrides['scopes'] ?? [];
        
        $hasAccess = $this->resolver->canAccess($role, $requestedScope, $scopeOverrides);
        
        return [
            'allowed' => $hasAccess,
            'tenant' => $tenantId,
            'scope' => $requestedScope,
            'role' => $role
        ];
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$baseConfig = [
    'routes' => ['/api/v1/data', '/api/v1/admin'],
    'permissions' => [
        'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'delete', 'admin.panel'],
        'user' => ['read'],
        'service' => ['read', 'write']
    ],
    'rate_limit' => ['default' => 100, 'premium' => 1000]
];

$roleHierarchy = [
    'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'delete', 'admin.panel', 'admin.users'],
    'user' => ['read', 'user.profile'],
    'service' => ['read', 'write', 'service.internal']
];

$config = new TenantConfig($baseConfig);
$resolver = new PermissionResolver($roleHierarchy);
$gateway = new GatewayMiddleware($config, $resolver);

// Handle API request
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] === '/api/tenant/customize') {
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!$input || !isset($input['tenant_id'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $input['tenant_id']);
    $customization = $input['customization'] ?? [];
    
    $success = $gateway->applyTenantCustomization($tenantId, $customization);
    echo json_encode(['success' => $success]);
    
} elseif ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] === '/api/check') {
    $tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $_GET['tenant'] ?? '');
    $role = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $_GET['role'] ?? 'user');
    $scope = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]/', '', $_GET['scope'] ?? 'read');
    
    $result = $gateway->handleRequest($tenantId, $role, $scope);
    echo json_encode($result);
}
